description: The image displays three pie charts, each representing the distribution of responses across three categories—W/o Demos (gray), Hard to Tell (blue), and W/ Demos (green)—for different types of content: "Funny Reddit," "Unhealthy Comments," and a third category labeled with a gray bar at the top. The legend at the top clarifies the color coding for the categories. The "Funny Reddit" pie chart shows that the "W/o Demos" category accounts for 41.5% of the responses, "Hard to Tell" accounts for 21.5%, and "W/ Demos" accounts for 37.1%. The "Unhealthy Comments" pie chart indicates that "W/o Demos" makes up 37.8%, "Hard to Tell" makes up 27.4%, and "W/ Demos" makes up 34.8%. The third pie chart, associated with the gray bar, shows that "W/o Demos" accounts for 43.0%, "Hard to Tell" accounts for 22.9%, and "W/ Demos" accounts for 34.1%. All percentages are clearly labeled within each slice of the respective pie charts.
